source.primary: Kim, J., Moin, P., & Moser, R. (1987). Turbulence statistics in fully developed channel flow at low Reynolds number. Journal of Fluid Mechanics, 177, 133-166.
source.secondary: Moser, R. D., Kim, J., & Mansour, N. N. (1999). Direct numerical simulation of turbulent channel flow up to Re_tau=590. Physics of Fluids, 11(4), 943-945.
source.provenance_note: Summary statistics widely reproduced across the turbulence-modeling literature citing the above. A fine-grained point-by-point u+(y+) DNS table could not be fetched from the live DNS database mirrors (turbulence.oden.utexas.edu, turbmodels.larc.nasa.gov) from this development sandbox -- see README.md's 'Provenance disclosure' section.

reynolds_number_convention.re_tau: u_tau * delta / nu, delta = channel half-height
reynolds_number_convention.re_bulk: U_bulk * H / nu, H = 2*delta (full channel height)
